The exact Poisson-square factorization reduces all Gram quadratic forms to a multiplier with minimum \(a-(1+r)\|v\|/\sqrt r\). Its sign gives sufficiency and a negative continuous integral witness outside the cone. Spherical polynomial density and positivity of all Poisson harmonic coefficients prove finite-site strictness at equality. The embedded checker passed 1,681 exact rational Fourier blocks, an exact outside-cone witness and 60 independent quadratures; these checks are corroboration, not the infinite proof.

value.rationale: The axially varying affine covariance kernel is a natural first anisotropic perturbation of spherical Poisson covariance. Its dimension-independent exact positivity cone is strictly stronger than pointwise nonnegative diagonal variance, provides an explicit admissibility rule for nonstationary covariance constructions, and has a nontrivial strict-positivity phenomenon at the degenerate integral-weight boundary. The bridging moment identity explains the structure. It is a full parameter classification of a motivated family, not an arbitrary small finite computation.
